notes.title: Minor Patch 4
notes.notes:
Features/QOL
- MAJOR: If an enemy is in combat at the end of a day they will not deal damage to the Player at the end of the day. Only dormant enemies deal damage to the Player at the end of days now.
- Removed the softlock at the start of the game where if you were to craft a wire instead of the locator you wouldn't be able to craft a locator

Bugs
- Removed the ability to stack chests
- Removed bug in blueprint selection popup ui where you can select multiple blueprints to unlock if you were quick enough to select more than one
- Fixed the bug of bots and the player going all over the board when attacking
- Fixed achievement "Professional Professor" to be given when ALL blueprints are unlocked

notes.title: Upcoming Bug Fixes & Features
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I've been listening to your feedback, and I wanted to update you on what I'll be working on in the next patch. Here's a breakdown of the bugs I'm planning to fix and the features I'm adding to improve your gameplay experience.

Bug Fixes

Achievements Not Unlocking: Achievements for leveling up and learning every blueprint aren't unlocking properly. I'll be fixing this to ensure your progress is rewarded as intended.

Bot Count Not Resetting: The number of bots doesn't reset after the game ends. This will be corrected so everything refreshes properly.

Softlock on Death with Blueprint Open: Opening a blueprint just before dying causes a softlock. I'll make sure this no longer traps you in limbo.

Feedback Button Change: The feedback button will be changed from F12 to something less likely to be triggered accidentally.

Chest Item Duplication Glitch: Placing an item on top of two chests can result in the item being sucked up twice. I'll make sure this no longer happens.

Combat/Job Overlap Bug: Similar to the chest bug, placing a bot or player on top of both a combat and a job can cause them to join the fight and start the job simultaneously. This will also be addressed.

Chest Dispensing Issue: Sometimes, dispensing items from one chest will incorrectly pull items from other chests. I'll track down the cause of this and get it fixed.

New Features

Lock Cards in Place: You'll be able to lock cards in place to prevent accidental movement.

Main Menu Access Without Exiting: A new option will allow you to return to the main menu without fully closing the game.

Multiple Display Resolutions: I'll be adding support for multiple display resolutions to better accommodate different screen setups.

Card Magnets: These will pull specific cards into their stack automatically, making organization easier.

Egg Sac Hatching: Egg sacs will hatch a new bug variant if left unattended for a period of time.

I'm committed to making the game better, and I appreciate your patience as I work through these issues. If you have any additional feedback or encounter other bugs, please let me know!

Thanks for playing, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Moving forward after botched release
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I somehow managed to set the price to free instead of the intended paid amount. Whoops! Honestly, this was a complete accident, and I wanted to be upfront with you all about what happened. Here's my Steam support ticket that was sent as soon as I released the game and saw the game was FREE. You can see how frantic I was based off how I spelled "percent" lol. I still haven't heard from Steam but will update when I do...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982265/0311b86896270e2d0914067cc2f195831f026d98.png
Now that I've had some time to reflect (and facepalm repeatedly), I'm unsure about the best way to move forward. Since many of you have already picked up the game during this unexpected "free release," I want to be fair to those who supported me early on and make the best decision for the community as a whole.

I see two potential options:

Switch the game to paid — I'd set the intended price and move forward as originally planned. Those who already claimed the game would, of course, keep it for free.

Introduce a "Supporter DLC" — This would be a separate, optional DLC for those who enjoyed the game and would like to support me directly. This option would allow everyone to keep the base game free while giving those who want to contribute a chance to do so.

I really value your input, so I'd love to hear what you think. Which option sounds better to you? Or maybe you have another idea altogether?

Please share your thoughts in the comments below. Your support means the world to me, and I'm incredibly grateful for the warm reception the game has received so far (even if I fumbled the launch).

Thanks for sticking with me through this chaotic adventure. Looking forward to hearing what you think!

notes.title: Full Release 1.0
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

So... I goofed. Big time. I accidentally released my game for free when that definitely wasn't the plan. While I'm happy that so many of you are enjoying it, this was a bit of a mistake on my end.

If you grabbed the game during this little mix-up, no worries at all — you’re absolutely welcome to keep it and enjoy! But if you're feeling generous and would like to support me and the game's development, there are a couple of ways you can help out:

Buy Me a Coffee: If you’d like to throw a few bucks my way, you can donate here: Kofi. Every bit helps me keep working on improving the game, adding new content, and fixing bugs.

Join My Discord: If you’d like to hang out, chat about the game, or share ideas, you can join my Discord here: Discord. It's also a great place to keep up with updates and provide feedback.

I really appreciate everyone who's checked out the game so far. This little mishap was an embarrassing mistake, but the support from this community means the world to me. Thanks for understanding, and I can’t wait to keep making the game even better with your help!

Much love, Wibert
